text:
Hannah L: Heads up — starting EU canary cutover for feature-service now. watching shadow and canary routes. please keep an eye on SLO dashboards and call out any 5xx blips.
deploy-bot: Deployment started for feature-service v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (canary 2%). change-window: 2026-03-22T10:00Z. link: https://console.redwood/services/feature-service/deploys/6387654321 :rocket:
Ajay P: saw a small uptick in shadow 5xx for a handful of requests around 10:03. not in canary metrics yet but mirrored traffic shows errors.
Maria G: jumping in — tailing logs now. sample from shadow: 
```
[10:03:12] ERROR request_id=abc123 handler=embed-gen status=502 stderr="CUDA OOM during kv cache load"
```
Maria G: that looks like a memory regressor from the new kernel selection path on long-seq requests. only in shadow so far.
Kevin S: p95 and p99 for canary are stable: p95=120ms, p99=420ms, error rate (canary) 0.05%. shadow error rate 0.9% on the same window. that's concerning.
Linda O: recommending we pause traffic shift and pin to v2.3.1 for the rest of the rollout until we triage. can we set a quick fallback?
Hannah L: agree with pause. Ajay, can you run the preflight rollback/pin command? keep canary running but stop progression.
Ajay P: running: `rosterctl deploy pause --service feature-service --deploy 6387654321 --hold=true`
SRE-Bot: Action recorded: hold applied by Ajay P at 2026-03-22T10:06Z. Canary progression halted. Alert emitted to #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.
Maria G: triage notes — root cause hypothesis: quantized kernel path picks new fused attention for >2048 tokens; memory accounting bug under certain batch shard layouts. repro with `python reproduce.py --seq 4096 --batch 4 --quantized` gives consistent OOM.
Kevin S: ok plan: 1) keep canary at 2% paused, 2) pin routing for critical traffic to v2.3.1, 3) run canary-only repro tests on an isolate GPU pool, 4) if repro confirmed, rollback canary to v2.3.1.
Linda O: executing pin: `trafficctl pin --service feature-service --version v2.3.1 --scope global --reason "safety pin after shadow 5xx"`
deploy-bot: Traffic pin recorded. Routing changed: default -> v2.3.1, canary remains isolated.
Hannah L: I'll update release notes and the change-window comment: "paused progression, pin applied, triage ongoing". tagging @security and @customersuccess in case of customer impact.
Ajay P: creating short postmortem draft and noting the exact request signatures that hit the regression. will attach logs and repro steps.
Maria G: saving heap profiles and kernel trace — uploading to the deploy artifact set: https://artifacts.redwood/services/feature-service/6387654321/triage-logs
Kevin S: if we can confirm repro, let's flip a canary rollback within the next 30m. current SLO deviation is contained to shadow but we shouldn't risk ramp.
SRE-Bot: Canary health summary: shadow_error_rate=0.9%, canary_error_rate=0.05%, system_load nominal. Next scheduled check in 5m.
Hannah L: thanks all. keep updates brief in-thread — if anything changes rapidly ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
Linda O: noted. I'll keep the hold until we have the repro confirmed or a safe patch.
Ajay P: tracking: follow-ups -> reproduce, kernel patch, 1-hr rollback window. prepping rollback checklist now.
Maria G: one-liner for changelog: "pause rollout v2.4.0 — investigating memory regression in quantized kernel path (shadow-detected 5xx)"
Hannah L: perfect. closing loop: we'll reconvene after the repro attempt. thanks.
